لُقْطَةٌ : see لَقَطٌ, throughout the first sentence. ―
-b2- Accord. to Lth, it [also] signifies A man who repeatedly and perseveringly seeks after things to be picked up, and picks them up: (TA:) and some say, that ↓ لُقَطَةٌ signifies one who picks up: but the more common and correct signification of this latter is “ property which is found, ” as before stated. (IAth.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
